title: 第一卷 第98章 铁牛娶了十八房老婆第一卷 第97章 重振雄风
slug: 凡人修仙从百岁老人娶妻开始
lines: 老者一揪胡子，指着远处阵法豪迈大笑，
“哈哈哈哈！小辈！这可是百年难见的大事！
前些时日，外围大阵被破，里面只有一重伤筑基和炼气圆满的李灵儿撑场面！
迟早完蛋！”
说到这里，他才抬头看向林寻，原本表情瞬间收敛换成谄媚，
“竟是炼气圆满前辈当面，不知晚辈，有什么可以效劳？”
“嗯？继续说你知道的。”
“是，是，前面是李氏仙族最后的阵法，我等.......”
片刻之后，林寻了解到最近发生的大事。
数年前，李氏仙族三位筑基老祖战死，最后一位筑基老祖负伤而返，固守山门。
而后散修一窝蜂地涌来。
有人寻仇，有人想捞好处。
外围大阵也被攻破，战火点燃家族的各个地方，到如今凄惨不已。
林寻当然不会对李氏怜悯，当年之事还历历在目，今日也是为了要个交代。
他负手离开，打算先观察李氏仙族的阵法。
据说相比于李氏，其余势力的情况好了不是一星半点。
当然这个结果，完全是李氏仙族咎由自取。
毕竟，一切都是由青云山坊市开始。
将那里所有的散修当做耗材，送去摸索秘境，简直人神共愤！
片刻之后，李氏仙族的阵法结界在望，一道粗犷的声音叫住林寻。
“这位道友，先停一下！”
林寻转身，疑惑的指了指自己，“叫我？”
炼气圆满的大汉迅速上前，“当然！道友也是来寻李氏仙族麻烦的？”
“是又如何，不是又如何？”
“呵呵，道友不必如此紧张，我等一样是准备攻破李氏的阵法，找他们要个交代。”
“你等？”林寻狐疑道。
“对，现在已经有六人，皆是炼气圆满以上的好手！
不如你也加入我们，到时候破开李氏仙族的阵法，我们共享所得如何？”
略微一听，林寻就明白过来。
这群散修是打算合力破阵？
他忍不住嘴角一抽，当年仙宗长老曾说过。
仙宗弟子，哪怕到了万不得已，也不可和散修组成同盟。
这群人聚是一坨翔，散是满天稀，没一个好货色。
事情没成之前就已经开始计较得失，做事毫无底线可言。
而林寻这些年，对散修可太了解了。
与他们合作，表现的太强不行，容易被怀疑有宝，不强也不行，会被觉得不配，好欺负。
毕竟都是底层讨生活的人，有八百个心眼子。
他可不愿意带上一群拖后腿的人。
不过等观察过后，还是无从下手的话，就推波助澜，把散修当枪使试探一番。
林寻笑了笑，道了声不用，再次向前而去。
content_en:
The old man tugged his beard, pointed at the formation in the distance and laughed boldly.
"Hahahaha! Junior! This is an event that is rare in a century!
A few days ago, the outer formation was broken, and there was only Li Ling'er, who was seriously injured and had completed his foundation building and Qi refining, to support the scene!
Sooner or later it will be over! "
Having said this, he raised his head and looked at Lin Xun. His original expression instantly changed into flattery.
"Senior Qi Refining Consummation is here in front of you. I wonder, junior, what can I do for you?"
"Huh? Keep talking about what you know."
"Yes, yes, ahead is the final formation of the Li Clan's Immortal Clan, I'll wait..."
After a while, Lin Xun learned about the recent major events.
A few years ago, three foundation-building ancestors of the Li Clan died in battle, and the last foundation-building ancestor returned injured and guarded the mountain gate.
Then the casual cultivators swarmed in.
Some people seek revenge, and some people want to gain benefits.
The outer formation was also breached, and the flames of war ignited various parts of the family. It is still miserable today.
Of course, Lin Xun would not show mercy to Mr. Li. The events of that year were still vivid in his mind, and today he wanted to get an explanation.
He left with his hands behind his hands, intending to observe the Li Clan's formation first.
It is said that compared to the Li family, the situation of other forces is not a little better.
Of course, this result is entirely the fault of the Li Immortal Clan.
After all, everything started from Qingyun Shanfang City.
Treating all the casual cultivators there as consumables and sending them to explore the secret realm is outrageous!
After a moment, the formation barrier of the Li Clan's Immortal Clan was in sight, and a rough voice called Lin Xun.
"Fellow Taoist, please stop for a moment!"
Lin Xun turned around and pointed at himself in confusion, "Call me?"
The big man who had perfected his Qi refining quickly stepped forward, "Of course! Fellow Taoist are also here to cause trouble for the Li Immortal Clan?"
“So what if it is, so what if it’s not?”
"Haha, fellow Taoist, don't be so nervous. We are also preparing to break Li's formation and ask them for an explanation."
"Are you waiting?" Lin Xun asked suspiciously.
"Yes, there are now six people, all of whom are masters of Qi Refining and above!
Why don't you join us and break through the formation of the Li Clan's Immortal Clan? How about we share the gains? "
After listening for a while, Lin Xun understood.
Are these casual cultivators planning to work together to break the formation?
He couldn't help but twitch the corner of his mouth. The elder of the Immortal Sect once said that back then.
Immortal Sect disciples should not form an alliance with casual cultivators even if it is absolutely necessary.
This group of people is like a bunch of people together, but scattered all over the sky, no one is good.
Before things are done, they have already begun to care about the gains and losses, and there is no bottom line in doing things.
And Lin Xun has become very familiar with casual cultivators over the years.
When cooperating with them, if you act too strong, you will easily be suspected of having a treasure. If you are not strong, you will be considered unworthy and easy to bully.
After all, they are all people at the bottom trying to make a living, and they have eight hundred ideas.
He didn't want to bring a group of people who were holding him back.
But after observing, if you still can't make a move, you can add fuel to the flames and test the casual cultivators as spearmen.
Lin Xun smiled, said no, and walked forward again.
